title: Compare constant cosine and KL-adaptive learning-rate schedules
doing: Propose constant, positive warmup-plus-cosine-to-floor and KL-adaptive schedules within both S3 warm-start and S4 scratch K1/K2/K3/K4 matrices. Use at least2 independent training seeds per cell; save scheduler configuration, raw-frame clock, current/group learning rates and KL-adaptation state with model/Adam/RNG. Recheck initial LR when effective batch changes. No schedule is adopted or launched.
expected: Warmup/cosine may reduce late policy drift and KL adaptation may control excessive updates, but neither is assumed to outperform constant LR. Starting LR, batch size, K and schedule can interact; historical manual drops and a single decay branch do not isolate schedule effects.
next_step: Implement and review an identity-bound scheduler successor with saved raw-frame clock and exact resume round-trip tests. Calibrate LR with batch, forecast all48 minimum fixed-matrix trajectories, then seek separate launch approval.
